<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#1F1E29" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="21" y="32" font-size="14" font-weight="500">9:41</text>
    <rect x="327" y="23" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <rect x="332" y="20" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <rect x="337" y="17" width="3" height="14" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <rect x="342" y="14" width="3" height="17" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="27" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="30" x2="364" y2="34" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="19" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="374" y="22" width="12" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <rect x="389" y="23" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="54" width="390" height="70" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="25,88 18,95 25,102" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="19" y1="95" x2="37" y2="95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="91" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Book a flight</text>
    <text x="54" y="109" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFD3D1">Find your next journey</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="91" r="17" fill="#932B5E"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="86" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="98" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main background and segmented controls -->
  <rect x="0" y="124" width="390" height="594" fill="#FAFAFB"/>
  <g font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="20" y="151" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Search flights</text>
    <text x="370" y="151" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="#DB6186">Need help?</text>
    
    <rect x="20" y="165" width="350" height="45" rx="10" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
    <rect x="22" y="167" width="112" height="41" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="78" y="193" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">One way</text>
    <text x="195" y="193" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#5F5E65">Round trip</text>
    <text x="315" y="193" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#5F5E65">Multi-city</text>
    
    <!-- Location card -->
    <rect x="19" y="226" width="352" height="144" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
    <rect x="18" y="224" width="352" height="144" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="258" r="8" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="258" r="3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="63" y="246" font-size="11" fill="#949499">FROM</text>
    <text x="63" y="267" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">New York</text>
    <text x="63" y="285" font-size="12" fill="#949499">JFK · John F. Kennedy Intl.</text>
    <line x1="34" y1="299" x2="352" y2="299" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="334" r="8" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="334" r="3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="63" y="322" font-size="11" fill="#949499">TO</text>
    <text x="63" y="343" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">London</text>
    <text x="63" y="360" font-size="12" fill="#949499">LHR · Heathrow Airport</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="297" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="291" x2="343" y2="303" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="291" x2="331" y2="303" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Date and travelers -->
    <rect x="19" y="384" width="170" height="78" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <rect x="199" y="384" width="171" height="78" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <text x="35" y="405" font-size="11" fill="#949499">DEPARTURE</text>
    <text x="35" y="430" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Jun 18, 2026</text>
    <text x="35" y="448" font-size="12" fill="#949499">Thursday</text>
    <rect x="35" y="412" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="409" x2="38" y2="415" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="409" x2="45" y2="415" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="215" y="405" font-size="11" fill="#949499">TRAVELERS</text>
    <text x="215" y="430" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">1 Adult</text>
    <text x="215" y="448" font-size="12" fill="#949499">Economy · 1 bag</text>
    <circle cx="218" cy="418" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="218" cy="435" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    
    <!-- Preferences -->
    <text x="20" y="497" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Preferences</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="512" width="167" height="52" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
      <circle cx="43" cy="538" r="10" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
      <line x1="38" y1="538" x2="48" y2="538" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="43" y1="533" x2="43" y2="543" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="62" y="543" font-size="13" fill="#323232">Direct flights only</text>
      <rect x="144" y="529" width="28" height="17" rx="9" fill="#7A1851"/>
      <circle cx="163" cy="537.5" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="203" y="512" width="167" height="52" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
      <circle cx="227" cy="538" r="10" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
      <line x1="222" y1="538" x2="232" y2="538" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="227" y1="533" x2="227" y2="543" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="246" y="543" font-size="13" fill="#323232">Flexible dates</text>
      <rect x="327" y="529" width="28" height="17" rx="9" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
      <circle cx="336" cy="537.5" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Search button -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="590" width="350" height="52" rx="11" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
      <rect x="20" y="588" width="350" height="52" rx="11" fill="#DB6186"/>
      <circle cx="158" cy="614" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="164" y1="620" x2="170" y2="626" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="195" y="620" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Search flights</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Promo card -->
    <rect x="20" y="664" width="350" height="40" rx="9" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="684" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="43,677 45,682 50,682 46,685 47,690 43,687 39,690 40,685 36,682 41,682" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="63" y="688" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Save more with member-only fares</text>
    <text x="349" y="688" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Join</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="718" width="390" height="126" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="718" x2="390" y2="718" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,752 50,743 61,752 61,763 54,763 54,755 46,755 46,763 39,763" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="50" y="785" font-size="11" fill="#949499">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Search active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="752" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="137" y1="759" x2="143" y2="765" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="130" y="785" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Search</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Trips -->
    <g>
      <rect x="204" y="744" width="22" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="204" y1="750" x2="226" y2="750" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="210" y1="741" x2="210" y2="747" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="741" x2="220" y2="747" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="215" y="785" font-size="11" fill="#949499">My trips</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Account -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="309" cy="749" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="309" cy="763" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="309" y="785" font-size="11" fill="#949499">Account</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="145" y="818" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1F1E29"/>
  </g>
</svg>
